title: Pehli Salary! 🎉
description: Teri pehli salary aayi! ₹25,000 haath mein hai. Sab celebrate karna chahte hain. Kya karega?

choices.text: ₹2,000 SIP shuru karo, baaki spend karo
choices.feedback: Smart move! SIP early shuru karna best financial decision hai.

choices.text: Dosto ke saath Goa trip book karo
choices.feedback: Memories banaye, but savings miss kar diye!
Safe choice! But thoda enjoy bhi karo yaar.

title: Medical Emergency! 🏥
description: Ghar mein kisi ko hospital admit karna pada. ₹20,000 ka bill aa gaya. Kya karega?

choices.feedback: Emergency fund isi liye hota hai! Great planning.
Credit card pe 36% interest lagega. Avoid karo!
Loan ek option hai, but emergency fund hona chahiye tha.

title: Phone Kharab Ho Gaya 📱
description: Tera phone kharab ho gaya. Naya phone lena hai (₹15,000 naya, ₹6,000 second-hand).

choices.feedback: Smart! Same kaam, kam paisa. Future score badha!
EMI ek trap hai — zero cost EMI mein bhi hidden charges hote hain.
Debt se bacha, good! Par savings thodi zyada gayi.

title: Dost Ka Birthday 🍽️
description: Dost ka birthday hai. Restaurant mein sab expect kar rahe hain ke tu treat dega. Bill ₹3,000 aaya.

choices.feedback: Generous ho! But budget mein rehna seekho.
Fair and smart! Good friends always split.
Creative aur budget-friendly! Best choice!

title: Salary Raise Mili! 💼
description: Boss ne ₹5,000 raise diya! Ab salary ₹30,000 hai. Kya karega iss extra paison ka?

choices.feedback: Lifestyle inflation se bacha! Savings badhaai — genius move!

choices.text: Better apartment mein shift ho jao
choices.feedback: Lifestyle inflation! Expenses bhi utni hi badhti hain.
Investing good hai, but research zaroor karo pehle!

title: Market Crash! 📉
description: Sensex 20% giraa! Tune mutual funds mein ₹30,000 invest kiye hain. Kya karega?

choices.text: Ruko aur invest karte raho (SIP continue)
choices.feedback: Sahi! Market corrections mein ghabhrana nahi chahiye. Long term sochte raho.

choices.text: Sab sell karo — loss mat karo!
choices.feedback: Galat! Panic selling sabse bada investing mistake hai.

choices.text: Aur paisa daal do — discount mein khariddo
choices.feedback: Warren Buffett strategy! 'Buy when others are fearful.' Smart!

title: Ghar Lena Hai? 🏡
description: Parents bol rahe hain ghar lo. ₹40 Lakh flat ka 20% down payment = ₹8 Lakh chahiye.

choices.feedback: Patient planning! Down payment zyada hoga toh EMI kam hogi.

choices.text: Abhi hi lo — 90% home loan pe
choices.feedback: High loan = high EMI burden for 20 years. Think carefully!
Renting is not wasted money — flexibility and savings matter too!

title: Retirement Planning 👴
description: Tu 25 saal ka hai. Retirement 60 pe — 35 saal hain. Abhi sochna chahiye?

choices.text: Haan! PPF/NPS shuru karo abhi se
choices.feedback: Compound interest ka jaadu! 35 saal mein ₹1,000/month → ₹1+ Crore!

choices.text: 30 ke baad sochenge — abhi enjoy karo
choices.feedback: 5 saal delay = decades of compound interest lost. Start NOW!
Real estate is illiquid. Diversification better hai!
